basic_info.description: Coastal living in this Charming Sanctuary! Experience this delightful partially detached single-family home, just steps from the breathtaking Ocean Beach in San Francisco's highly desirable Outer Sunset neighborhood.   As you enter, a bright and airy living room welcomes you, complete with a cozy wood-burning fireplaceperfect for chilly evenings by the shore. The beautifully updated kitchen features sleek granite countertops, a gas stove, & a convenient adjacent dining area, ideal for casual meals or festive gatherings. The main level offers a spacious bedroom, complemented by refinished hardwood floors & double-pane windows that flood the space with natural light. The modern, stylish bathroom includes a shower over the tub for a relaxing soak.  Walking downstairs, discover an additional bedroom on the bottom floor providing versatilityperfect for a guest room, home office, or creative space. Enjoy the expansive basement with ample storage for all your beach gear and more, along with a spacious one-car garage and additional driveway parking. The landscaped backyard is a peaceful retreat, offering the perfect setting for morning coffee or weekend BBQs.  This home is a beach lover's paradise.
